apaṇḍara：အ-ပဏ္ဍရ（တိ）
မည်းနက်သော။
DOP: paṇḍara mfn. and n. [ cf S. pāṇḍara], 1. ( mfn. ) whitish-yellow, white; bright; Abh 95 (sukko … setapaṇḍarā); Ja III 29, 12´ (odanaṃ suciṃ ~aṃ); 394, 23 (imehi kāḷakesehi parivattitvā … ~ehi bhavitabbaṃ); VI 22, 28* (vāḷavījaniṃ uṇhīsaṃ khaggaṃ chattaṃ ca ~aṃ); Nidd I 355, 9 (odātaṃ hoti … setaṃ ~aṃ …; Nidd-a I 377, 16 : setaṃ ~an ti dvīhi pi ati-odātataṃ dasseti); Ap 379, 3 (anāvilaṃ mama cittaṃ visuddhaṃ ~aṃ sadā); Mil 246, 14 (idaṃ tathāgatasāsanaṃ … vimalaṃ ~aṃ anavajjaṃ); Ps I 167, 21 (āgantukehi malehi saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ vatthaṃ pakatiyā °-ttā puna dhoviyamānaṃ ~aṃ hoti); III 105, 19 (maggacetanāya añño °-taro dhammo nāma natthi); — 2. ( n. ) ( i ) what is white or bright; Sn 526 (dubhayāni viceyya ~āni ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca … paṇḍito tādi pavuccate; Pj II 430, 2 : ~ānī ti āyatanāni, tāni hi pakatiparisuddhattā rūḷhiyā ca evaṃ vuccanti); Nidd I 3, 5 (cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ ~aṃ …; Nidd-a I 22, 18 : [cittaṃ] parisuddhaṭṭhena ~aṃ, bhavaṅgaṃ sandhāy’ etaṃ vuttaṃ) ≠ Dhs 6; — ( ii ) one of the types of elephant; Abh 361; Ps II 25, 35* (kāḷāvakaṃ ca gaṅgeyyaṃ ~aṃ tambapiṅgalaṃ); 26, 5 (yaṃ dasannaṃ gaṅgeyyānaṃ [balaṃ] taṃ ekassa ~assa); — °’- aṅga , m. [paṇḍara + aṅga 2 ; cf AMg paṃduraṅga, BHS pāṇḍarabhikṣu], a member of a certain sect (with body smeared with ashes? ?); Sp 254, 3 (ājīvako tāpaso paribbājako ~o ti maṃ dhārehī ti); Spk I 261, 3 (~-pabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā); — ° âvaraṇa , m.n. , a lip (which covers the white teeth); ? Ja V 155, 29* (~ā … catutthamanasannibhā; 156, 27´ : ~ā ti dantāvaraṇā … abhirattavasena jivhāsadisaṃ te oṭṭhapariyosānan ti vadati); — apaṇḍara , mfn. , not white; dark, black; Th 599; Ja V 156, 3* ; — see also jātipaṇḍarakesaka ( sv jāti 1 ), dhammapaṇḍarachattaka ( sv dhamma 1 ).
CPD: a-paṇḍara , mfn. ( cf. sa. pāṇḍara), not white, i.e. black; m. ~o aṇḍa-sambhavo, Th 599 (= kāḷa- vaṇṇo . . . kāko, Th-a); n. pl. ~ā (nettā), Ja V 156, 3 * (="kaṇhā, Ct. ). a-paṇḍara

apaṇḍita.p: [Na+paṇḍita] (ti) CL=9 Who is not a wise person; Uneducated- unwise; not a good/ noble person.
a: ပဏ္ဍိတမဟုတ်သောသူ၊ ပညာ-မရှိ-မဲ့-သော၊ သူ။ သူတော်ကောင်း မဟုတ်သောသူ။

C: apaṇḍita：a. [a-paṇḍita] 不明智（賢明）的，愚笨不聰明的 （不擅長的，技巧不精通的）.

apaṇḍita：အ-ပဏ္ဍိတ（ပ）
ပညာ မရှိသောသူ။
DOP: paṇḍita mfn. and m. [ ts ], wise; intelligent; shrewd, clever; a wise or learned man; Abh 227; Vin III 135, 8 (kumārikā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā ~ā vyattā medhāvinī dakkhā analasā); D I 137, 29 (~o vyatto medhāvī paṭibalo atītānāgatapaccuppanne atthe cintetuṃ); II 346, 18 (sotthinā taṃ kantāraṃ nitthariṃsu yathātaṃ ~ena satthavāhena pariṇāyakena); M III 170, 18 (tīṇ’ imāni … ~assa °-lakkhaṇāni °-nimittāni °âpadānāni); S I 63, 22 (~o bhante āyasmā Sariputto mahāpañño … puthupañño … hasapañño …); 87, 8* (atthābhisamayā dhīro ~o ti pavuccati); III 138, 30 (yaṃ bhikkhave natthi sammataṃ loke ~ānaṃ ahaṃ pi taṃ natthī ti vadāmi); V 151, 5 (~o vyatto kusalo sūdo); A I 101, 8 (yāni kānici bhikkhave bhayāni uppajjanti sabbāni tāni bālato uppajjanti no ~ato); 162, 29* (anupubbena nibbānaṃ adhigacchanti ~ā); II 118, 32 (imasmiṃ … ṭhāne bālo ca ~o ca veditabbo); 180, 28 (samaṇo Rāmaputto rañño Eḷeyyena ~ena °-taro, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr paṇḍitaro); III 58, 17 (~o vyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c’ eva arahā ca); IV 223, 20 (nijjhattibalā ~ā); Khp 5:2 (asevanā ca bālānaṃ ~ānaṃ ca sevanā … etaṃ maṅgalam uttamaṃ); Dhp 157 (tiṇṇam aññataraṃ yāmaṃ paṭijaggeyya ~o); 258 (na tena ~o hoti yāvatā bahu bhāsati); Sn 526 (dubhayāni viceyya paṇḍarāni … ~o tādi pavuccate; Pj II 429, 29 : paṇḍarāni ito upagato pavicayapaññāya allīno ti pi ~o ti vuccati); 721 (aḍḍhakumbhūpamo bālo rahado pūro va ~o); Th 582 (nātivelaṃ pabhāseyya saṅghamajjhamhi ~o); Thī 213 (kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno api bālo ~o assa); Ja I 337, 28´ (dhammasabhāya vinicchayaṭṭhāne pi ~e vohārakusale mahallake amacce na ṭhapessanti); II 357, 8* (sabbakiccesu ~o); III 116, 1 (majjhimadese manussā nāma ~ā te pañhaṃ pucchanti); 318, 23´ (~o ti ñāṇasampanno); 349, 19* (na ~ā vetanam ādiyanti citrāhi gāthāhi subhāsitāhi); V 59, 5 (yattha yattha ~ā vasanti sabbāni tāni ṭhānāni upasaṅkamitvā sakalajambudīpe pañhaṃ vissajjetāraṃ alabhitvā); 255, 8* (upamāya p’ idh’ ekacce atthaṃ jānanti ~ā); 285, 8 (°-ttā); VI 330, 4 (atthadhammānusāsakā cattāro ~ā); 343, 17´ (so pitaraṃ āsanā uṭṭhāpetvā sayaṃ nisīdati imaṃ ~o ti vattuṃ ayuttan ti); 465, 5* (~ā hi sukhāvahā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~amhi); 329, 2* foll. (bahujjano pasanno si disvā ~a-m-āgate ~amhi anuppatte celukkhepo pavattatha; 329, 6´ foll.: ~e āgate taṃ ~aṃ disvā bahujano pasanno ahosi) = 465, 25* foll. ( Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~am āgataṃ; 465, 30´ : ~e mithilaṃ āgate, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~aṃ… āgataṃ); Nidd I 124, 27 (~o ti buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī); Ap 562, 23 foll. (na hi sabbesu ṭhānesu puriso hoti ~o itthī pi ~ā hoti tattha tattha vicakkhaṇā); Dhs 1301 (hiri ca ottappaṃ ca ime dhammā ~ā sabbe pi kusalā dhammā ~ā); Mil 28, 31 (kathaṃ bhante Nāgasena ~ā sallapantī ti); Vism 73, 32* (tasmā araññavāsamhi ratiṃ kayirātha ~o); Pj I 34, 25 (°-tā); It-a II 117, 5 (paṭivedhabāhusaccena ~o); Sadd 356, 19 (paḍi gatiyaṃ: paṇḍati paṇḍā ~o); — ° âpadāna , n. [paṇḍita + apadāna 1 ], the action of a wise man; M III 170, 19 (°-lakkhaṇāni °-nimittāni ~āni, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr °-padānāni) = A I 102, 30 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr °-padānāni); — °’- ābhāsa , mfn. , appearing to be wise; Vin I 349, 28* (parimuṭṭhā ~ā, Be, Ce so; in Ee, Se written paṇḍitā bhāsā) = M III 154, 4* ( Be so; in Ce, Ee, Se written paṇḍitā bhāsā) = Ud 61, 10* ( Be, Ce so; in Ee, Se written paṇḍitā bhāsā; Ud-a 319, 3 : ~ā ti °-paṭirūpakā) = Ja III 488, 3* ; — °- manti(n) , m. , a wise counsellor; Ja VI 370, 12 ; — °- māni(n) , mfn. , thinking oneself to be wise; Dhp 63 (bālo ca ~ī sa ve bālo ti vuccati); Ja V 241, 12* (ete asappurisā loke bālā ~ino); Vism 201, 17 ; Pj II 306, 10 (bāhusaccamadena matto ~ī); Th-a III 141, 5 (sutaparamassa ~ino garahavasena); — °- mānika , mfn. , thinking oneself to be wise; Ps II 329, 3 ; — apaṇḍita , mfn. , not wise; unintelligent, foolish; Ja VI 353, 25 ; Sp 851, 8 (sace pi sāmaṇero ~o hoti); Ps II 284, 12 (~-tāya); Nidd-a I 199, 16 (bālānan ti ~ānaṃ); Sadd 219, 5 (~-jātiko); — atipaṇḍita , mfn. , very wise; too clever; Ja II 58, 7´ ; Mil 81, 9 (tumhe kho bhante Nāgasena ~ā ye tumhe asantānaṃ dukkhānaṃ pahānāya vāyamathā ti); Dhp-a II 29, 20 (~-tāya); — supaṇḍita , mfn. , very wise; Vibh-a 405, 14 .
CPD: a-paṇḍita , mfn. [ ts. ] , unlearned, stupid; — °-jātika, mfn. , Ja Vl 414, 16 ' (= 'asabbhi-rūpa'); Sadd 219, 5 ; — °-purisa, m. , Mp ll 168, 14 (bālo ~o).
